name: Hariya Tsunejirou
source:
He is known as Haritsune-san. He is the head clerk of an employment agency that specializes in young girls as housemaids.

He stands at 5'9"(~180cm).

Publicly, his job is to assist girls finding employment. but behind the scenes, he is rumored to be a dangerous human trafficker. He has a certain aesthetic regarding what Ochaya's he visits. He has no interest in anyone being his playmates unless they are young prostitutes.

He has a bitter feelings toward Kurojii, who snatches up the best prostitutes. He is polite to everyone. Strangely enough, he is very friendly to Ennosuke.
